Man Charged with Murder After Woman Found Dead in Canberra Fire

ACT police have charged a 27-year-old man with the murder of Kylee McHugh in Canberra. McHugh was found dead in her home after a fire. The man is also accused of setting the house on fire. In a separate incident in London, a 39-year-old man was found dead with fatal head injuries in a flat. Another report from London stated a man in his 40s was arrested on suspicion of murder after a woman and man were found stabbed to death in a home.
